newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Britain's Prince Charles arrives in Kuwait.
newsitem.headline: Britain's Prince Charles arrives in Kuwait.

text.p: Britain's Prince Charles arrived in Kuwait on Friday aboard an aircraft provided by the country's Emir Sheikh Jaber al-Ahmad al-Sabah.

The prince will on Saturday address a seminar on economic liberalisation aboard the royal yacht Britannia, his official residence during the Gulf tour, which also includes Bahrain and Qatar. He leaves Kuwait late on Saturday night.
British diplomats said Prince Charles, who visited the United Arab Emirates in December, plans to make an official visit to Saudi Arabia later this year.
